summary: Preserve forced shutdown during remote-close draining and report maintenance deadline failures once.

replay.detail: No replay or replication behavior changes.

schema.detail: No persistent schema or data representation changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or coordinated upgrade changes.

compatibility.detail: Normal shutdown still drains admitted close writes. A second termination or interrupt signal now bypasses that drain immediately, including when another operation holds the writer. Maintenance owns its budget diagnostic; unrelated failures remain reported.

downtime.detail: No startup migration or interruption required.

recovery.detail: Forced shutdown may leave a remote close for a later maintenance sweep, as any forced process termination can.
